name: retrofit
title: Retrofit a hand-rolled loop

origin.source: A realistic while-loop tool-calling agent converted into an agent machine, step by step (docs/from-a-loop.md)

comparison.purpose: before.ts is a genuinely tangled support-ticket agent built on raw AI SDK generateText: a while(true) loop, phase strings + boolean flags, nested if/else tool dispatch, an inline retry/backoff wrapper, a $100 refund limit as an `if`, and a human-approval pause faked with a { pending } sentinel + resume closure. step1/step2/step3 walk the refactor (phases → states, if/else → agent.decide + guard, sentinel → idle state), each shippable with the same observable behavior. index.ts is the final form; index.test.ts uses simulateAgent to prove the refactor preserved behavior on the happy and escalation paths.

starters: My order arrived smashed and I want a refund for the $45 mug.
I was charged twice for order ORD-1234 — please fix this.
